title: 方位介词 on / in / under
unitTitle: Module 3 Places and activities — In the classroom 在教室里

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 on / in / under
questions.question: 「它在桌子上。」的英文是（　）

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 on / in / under
questions.question: 「书包在椅子下面。」应说（　）
options: The bag is under the chair.
The bag is on the chair.
The bag is in the chair.
questions.answer: The bag is under the chair.

questions.knowledge_point: 方位介词 on / in / under
questions.question: in 表示「在……里面」。

knowledge.point: 方位介词 on / in / under
knowledge.core_concept: on 在……上面、in 在……里面、under 在……下面。句型 Where is…? It's on the desk.
knowledge.key_formula: It's on the desk. / It's in the bag.
knowledge.tips: 接触表面用 on，包在里面用 in。
